newsitem.title: UK: WPP Group director Salama sells shares.
newsitem.headline: WPP Group director Salama sells shares.

text.p: British advertising company WPP Group Plc said on Thursday that director Eric Salama sold 100,000 ordinary shares early this week at 249 pence per share.
After the sale on Monday, Salama's beneficial holding was 298,215 shares, representing 0.0402 percent of WPP's issued ordinary share capital.

He also held options over 67,227 shares exercisable between September 1997 and September 2004 and options over 90,909 shares exercisable between September 1998 and September 2005, WPP said in a statement.
WPP shares were unchanged at 254p at 1115 GMT.
